references.text: The book of Psalms highlights that God's word and actions are pure and open, echoing the idea that nothing is hidden that will not be revealed.
Luke repeats the same concept as in Matthew, emphasizing that secrets will be exposed.
Luke again emphasizes that nothing is hidden that will not become known, paralleling Matthew's message.
The book of Acts points out that God's plans and truths will be revealed, in line with Matthew's assurance that what is hidden will be made known.
